p: sin: According as all men die, for as much as they are sinners.
cause before the LORD: That is, their matter to be judged, to know what he should determine, as he did all hard matters.
judgment: Meaning, an ordinance to judge by.
spirits of all flesh: Who as he has created, so he governs the hearts of all men.
go out before them: That is, govern them and do his duty, as in 2Ch 1:10.
lay thine hand upon him: And so appoint him governor.
put some of thine honour upon: Commend him to the people as suitable for the office and appointed by God.
judgment of Urim before the LORD: According to his office: signifying that the civil magistrate could execute nothing but that which he knew to be the will of God.
charge: How he should govern himself in his office.
